_comment: Manifest of public datasets pulled by scripts/fetch_data.py. Add an entry here to pull a new source.

sources.title: Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark (SKAB) v0.9
sources.description: Real water-circulation pump testbed. 8 sensors at about 1 Hz, with labeled anomalies and changepoints.
sources.citation: Katser, I. D. and Kozitsin, V. O. (2020). Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark (SKAB). Kaggle. https://doi.org/10.34740/KAGGLE/DSV/1693952

sources.title: Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB), known-cause files
sources.description: Single-channel real-world series with documented anomaly windows, including an industrial machine temperature sensor that ends in a failure.
sources.citation: Ahmad, S., Lavin, A., Purdy, S., Agha, Z. (2017). Unsupervised real-time anomaly detection for streaming data. Neurocomputing.
